observed_strengths: Public tested-policy/checkpoint state is mechanically separated from evaluator-only ground truth and known evaluator keys are rejected recursively.
TransferCase binds distinct source/target fixture identities, generations, public fixture digests and opaque holdout-set identifiers.
RecoveryCheckpoint binds exact transfer-case and policy digests plus episode/generation, target public fixture, step, observation and action-history digests.
MatchedRecoveryComparison requires the same transfer-case digest, evaluator target-fixture digest and action budget for COLD_RESTART versus CHECKPOINT_RESUME.
Repository CI passes the declared 12 deterministic falsification tests and the component explicitly cannot mint runtime or whole-system credit.

material_gaps.finding: MatchedRecoveryComparison does not bind the two measured runs to the same post-change public starting observation, episode identity/generation, step index or start-state digest. EvaluatorRunMeasurement contains no such start identity.
material_gaps.risk: Same transfer case + hidden target fixture + budget can be compared even if the cold and resume runs began from non-equivalent public states, confounding recovery benefit.
material_gaps.falsifier: Construct a checkpoint-resume measurement sealed at one public observation and a cold measurement conceptually declared from a different public observation; if comparison creation succeeds because start identity is absent, the gap is reproduced.

material_gaps.finding: No deterministic post-change oracle/reference-plan result is bound into a case or comparison.
material_gaps.risk: Final score/action-count deltas cannot distinguish efficient correct repair from a cheaper but suboptimal or semantically different trajectory when evaluator scoring alone is insufficient.
material_gaps.falsifier: Add a fixture whose post-change shortest/optimal valid plan is deterministically computable and show that two terminal runs can have different regret while the current summary has no oracle-regret field.

material_gaps.finding: WP800 MicroWorldFixture already exposes evidence_source_family, donor_path_family and method_family, but WP805 TransferCase does not bind or compare them. It only rejects equal opaque holdout_set_id values.
material_gaps.risk: Relabeling structurally same-family fixtures can satisfy the current transfer distinctness gate, so a new identifier need not represent held-out structural transfer.
material_gaps.falsifier: Build source/target WP800 fixtures with different holdout labels but identical evidence-source, donor-path and method families and verify that current TransferCase accepts them.

material_gaps.finding: The benchmark has source and target identities but no typed perturbation/change identity, declared generation boundary or evaluator-owned causal dependency footprint.
material_gaps.risk: The benchmark measures transfer between fixtures, not necessarily recovery from one controlled localized change, weakening causal interpretation of selective repair.

material_gaps.finding: replayed_steps and repeated_work_steps are bounded caller-supplied counters; no consumed action/search/dependency trace digest proves what work was replayed, retained or still valid.
material_gaps.risk: Efficiency deltas can be internally consistent while the semantic validity of reused material is unverified.

material_gaps.finding: Measurements include actions/replay/repeated-work and evaluator score, but not model-call count, input/output tokens, latency or CPU/RSS/GPU/I/O metrics required by the Trigger-6 efficiency protocol where applicable.
material_gaps.risk: Action savings can hide higher planning/model/resource cost.

material_gaps.finding: The merged source directly imports WP800 ObservationView only; E1 requested mapping onto accepted WP800/WP802/WP803 and emerging WP804 interfaces, but WP802 information seeking, WP803 prediction and WP804 goal-history/goal-inference artifacts are not causally bound by this component.
material_gaps.risk: A standalone recovery benchmark can pass without measuring whether the integrated cognitive substrate actually transfers/replans better.

architecture_disposition.rationale: The merged component is a useful fail-closed comparison scaffold and has repository CI evidence, but current matching and provenance fields do not yet identify the causal quantity claimed by recovery-efficiency research.
minimum_repair_shape: Add a typed evaluator-owned RecoveryPerturbation/RecoveryScenario binding source, target, change identity/generation and causal footprint without exposing hidden truth to the SUT.
Bind both cold and resume measurements to one exact post-change public start identity; cold restart should differ by retained planner/checkpoint state, not by observed world state.
Add a deterministic post-change oracle/reference result when the micro-world permits it and report score/path/action regret separately from resource cost.

Bind explicit structural split metadata from WP800 evidence_source_family, donor_path_family and method_family, or a digest of a declared family vector, and fail closed on forbidden overlap for the selected transfer experiment.
Derive replay/repeated-work/reuse metrics from an exact trace/dependency receipt rather than accepting only unbound counters; preserve a digest and validity classification for retained material.
Add an evaluator-only optional resource vector for model calls, tokens, latency and host resources when the system under test actually uses them.
Only after these gates, map the recovery scenario to WP802/WP803/WP804 outputs and use Trigger-4 measured outcomes for any E4/E6 promotion.

counterhypothesis: For the small deterministic WP800 micro-world regime, full cold replanning may remain cheaper and more reliable than maintaining reusable repair state. The benchmark must permit a neutral or negative result for checkpoint/selective recovery rather than rewarding reuse by construction.
next_exact_action: Acquire a separate E3 create-only claim and run an exact-source deterministic falsifier for G1 matched-start identity and G3 structural-family relabeling. If reproduced, emit a minimal architecture delta to Trigger-4; do not modify F2 product source from Trigger-6 and do not grant E4/runtime/whole-system credit.
